name: accidental-sharp
description: A musical sharp with upright stems and two rising crossbars.
useCase: Apply a sharp accidental to raise a written pitch by one semitone.
misuse: Use hash for a channel or topic tag.

16.reason: Upright stems and rising crossbars distinguish the musical sharp from a hash.

24.reason: The larger sharp keeps upright stems and two full rising crossbars around an open center.
